scope: Proposition 3.3 of the manuscript “Power-law violations of Yau's nodal upper bound” (preprints/Power-law-violations-of-Yaus-nodal-upper-bound-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 350 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b8b6757d7a3a49d7), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 11-12. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: After fixing the data of Lemma 3.1 and possibly shrinking G, there are common constants γ > 0 and c > 0 with the following property. For every smooth G ∈ G and all sufficiently large k, there is a smooth real envelope h = hk on B such that h = −a∗t + ck on {t ≤ 1/2} and ∥h∥Cj ≤ Cjkδ(j+1) for every fixed integer j ≥ 0, max |e|G=1 dh(e)=0 Jh(e) ≥ ck−δ on {t ≥ 1/4}, ∫ V √ 1 + |∇Gh|2 G dx ≥ ckγ . (3.15) 11 Here δ = 10−6, and the chart Ω and region V ⋐ Ω are fixed. All corrugations are supported in one fixed initial cube compactly contained in V . The constants ck may be any bounded prescribed real numbers. The exponent γ and all construction parameters are independent of derivative orders, subsequent accuracy requirements, and round gluing collars. Constants Cj may depend on the order, the fixed smooth metric and coordinate systems, and the bound for |ck|; no uniform bound as j → ∞ is asserted.
